hooks.logic:
Set the next state to 0.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
Let part3 be part 3 of the enemy.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let v be if this state's '_haveEverDeltaAttack' then 30 else 100.
  If part2 is alive and part3 is alive and not (part2 has the REFLECTION status) and util passes a fraction roll of v, then
    Set this state's '_haveEverDeltaAttack' to true.
    Set the next state to 21.
    Reset part and stop.
  Part picks and uses a weighted random move.
If part2 is ready to act, then
  If part is dead and part3 is dead and util passes a fraction roll of 50, then
    Set the next state to 27.
    Reset part2 and stop.
  Part2 picks and uses a weighted random move.
If part3 is ready to act, then
  If part2 is alive and part2 has the REFLECTION status, then part3 uses the move labelled (call helper) with options {activeTarget: part2}.
  Otherwise, part3 picks and uses a weighted random move.
